KiCad placement: original vs optimized

Middle and right panels use the same two-layer PathFinder router (0.4 mm grid, pads as obstacles, SMD pads on the side the placement puts them, up to 12 rounds, power/ground nets excluded) so the two placements are compared on equal terms. Footprint colour shows the side each placement puts it on; with --sides single every footprint shares one plane, so bottom-side parts of the original board overlap top-side parts.
